turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, I'm here. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero?
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Almost unnervingly well-spoken. Every sentence perfectly built.
Twenty years of depositions will do that. Save the compliments, Hale. What do you have on Owen's essay?
It's impressive. Do you ever just relax?
Not in a meeting about my son's zero. Ten minutes ago you had something to tell me, Hale, so I'm waiting.
